notes.title: Game Tips # 3 - Use the Flashlight / Map / Log-Viewer
notes.content:
1. In case you find things too dark, press the 'F' key to turn ON/OFF the flashlight.

2. If you are lost or do not understand what to do in the forest, press the "M" key to display the HOLO-MAP. This will show you a simple path to follow to your objectives. Remember, the path displayed is a straight line in the map, you might have to zig-zag a bit.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27783874/40cc4433c164b179d47ddf574e0dd24530c9c991.jpg[/img]

3. Also remember to look for & read / listen to the HOLO-LOGs. They will inform you about your OBJECTIVES and options INFO section. You can view / scroll / listen to these logs separately by pressing the "O" key. Press "I" to turn off the messages.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27783874/352cb905db210d74650c196c430cc88c25eb4f50.jpg[/img]

4. Find your way to the upper levels on the trees from the ground. There's a lot more action and different enemies up there!

notes.title: Game Tips # 1
notes.content:
Episode 1 - Ground Zero (Level 1)

1. To find your way through the forest, use the simple HOLO-MAP (Press 'M' key). It shows a straight forward route, so you might need to take some twists and turns.

2. Remember to view / listen to those HOLO-LOG messages as you encounter them. They have vital information.

3. Unless really required (or you have a powerful weapon) don't bother fighting with the giant lake dwelling snakes. Just get away from them as quickly as possible.
